scripts.pretypecheck: pnpm --filter @workspace/inventory-math exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @workspace/spec-import exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @workspace/recipe-guide-import exec tsc -b --force
scripts.test:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome)} playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:multi-device: E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium)} playwright test --config playwright.multi-device.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ai-outage:phone: E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium)} playwright test --config playwright.ai-outage-phone.config.ts
scripts.check:e2e:ai-outage:phone:device: node --input-type=module -e 'const ready = Boolean(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_MOBILE_WS_ENDPOINT?.trim()); console.log(`Physical-device readiness: ${ready ? "READY" : "BLOCKED"}`); console.log("Required connection: Android Chrome on a physical device"); if (!ready) { console.error("Playwright was not started. Configure the injected device service connection and retry."); process.exit(2); } console.log("Device endpoint: configured (value hidden)");'
scripts.test:e2e:ai-outage:phone:device: pnpm run check:e2e:ai-outage:phone:device && E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 playwright test --config playwright.ai-outage-phone.config.ts --project=real-mobile-chromium
scripts.test:e2e:a11y: E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium)} playwright test --config playwright.a11y.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phone: E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium)} playwright test --config playwright.phone.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visual: E2E_TEST_DB=1 E2E_APPROVED_DESTRUCTIVE_MODE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH:-$(command -v chromium)} playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phone:device: test -n "${PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_MOBILE_WS_ENDPOINT:-}" || { echo 'Set PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_MOBILE_WS_ENDPOINT to a Playwright/CDP endpoint connected to physical Android Chrome.' >&2; exit 2; }; playwright test --config playwright.phone.config.ts --project=real-mobile-chromium --grep @real-mobile-browser
